ourStory: From the very beginning, Daphine and Adams knew their story was being written by a greater hand. Through laughter, prayer, and everyday moments that slowly became forever, their friendship blossomed into a love rooted in faith and gratitude to God. "He has made everything beautiful in its time" (Ecclesiastes 3:11) has become more than a verse to them — it's the story of how two hearts found their perfect season. Now, surrounded by family and friends, they can't wait to begin this next beautiful chapter together as husband and wife.
preWeddingDressNote: Optional: African Kitenge / Ankara warmly welcomed.
contributionsIntro: As preparations continue, invited guests are kindly encouraged to make their wedding contributions early — this helps secure each guest's seat and enables the planning committee to make arrangements in a timely manner. For family and friends who are unable to attend, your love, prayers, and financial support are sincerely appreciated.
dressNote: Wedding Ceremony attire: Green with a Touch of Gold. Shades of green — from deep emerald to soft sage — paired with gold accents, with ivory/white as an elegant accent too.
inviteLine: With joyful hearts and gratitude to God, we invite you to celebrate our wedding
rsvpIntro: Your presence will be a great honor as family and friends gather to celebrate God's faithfulness, His love, and the beginning of our new chapter together.
footerNote: Thank you for your love, prayers, generosity, and support
